pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or adding to floating losses; scale-in is authorized only after a trade achieves +$3.00 in open profit and forms a confirmed higher-low structure.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR-based volatility expansion confirmation and a minimum 3-pip buffer beyond local micro-support/resistance prior to order placement to avoid wick hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00, trailing the remaining balance dynamically with an aggressive step-lock to capture tails up to +$30.00.
